tonight.headline: Golden is questionable; Pickens is ready
body: Bad news first: Matthew Golden is questionable for Thursday with a shoulder and a foot, limited on Wednesday's final report. Bloodsports are 1-6.
The lineup as set is the projection lineup — 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.2, 53%. The only live decision is Pickens for Golden if he is inactive at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala start St. Brown, who missed Wednesday's practice (NBC/PFT headline 28 Oct), and Caleb Williams at quarterback; Olave is benched on a Saints bye.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Golden inactive and the swap not made — 15 projected points become zero.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · inactives Thu 29 Oct 16:45 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Golden is inactive, Pickens takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Carried and re-checked: questionable, limited Wednesday. Check inactives at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Shoulder and foot. Green Bay held nothing more than walkthroughs this week; Golden moved up to limited on Wednesday's final report and is questionable (NBC/PFT 28 Oct 15:06).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: George Pickens, 14.0 — 1.1 below Golden, inside the coin-flip line, so nothing is lost by playing safe once Golden is in doubt. Pickens was a full participant by 23 Oct after a shoulder limit (DallasCowboys.com).

case.label: The clock
case.body: Inactives 90 minutes before Thursday's 18:15 kickoff: 16:45 CDMX. Golden's slot locks at kickoff.

case.label: Contested
case.body: ESPN tagged Pickens QUESTIONABLE in its 22:20Z refresh, after this snapshot, with no report explaining it (a shoulder limited him on 22 Oct). He still plays Sunday, so he stays the fallback: if he is then ruled out, Rashee Rice (Sunday 15:25) takes the slot before Pickens' 12:00 kickoff.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and Pickens outscores him (archive) — that would say the contingency was right to exist but the questionable tag was noise. If Golden sits, untestable.

whatWentWrong.title: Golden is still questionable — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: Shoulder and foot; limited on Wednesday's final report after walkthrough-only sessions.

case.label: What happened
case.body: He played through the shoulder in Week 7 (12 targets, archive); the foot is new this week.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Do-first fallback: Pickens if he is inactive at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and plays a full share — then the questionable tag was precautionary.
